description:
Title: Car Service

The police has a new app to remind you of your car service.
The process is started after a successful service.
When a service is necessary, the system checks if your car is still registered.
If it is registered, you are notified.
If you do not go to the service, you are fined after 30 days.
At the car service facility the mechanic enters the problems of your car for reference.
While you wait (can take several days), you get status updates via email.
You can pay through the app, when the repair is done.
The mechanic enters that the repair was successful and you got your "Pickerl".
The mechanic enters the time for you next service.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceRecorded" name="Record successful service" sourceRef="Task_NextService" targetRef="Start_ServiceRecorded"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceVisit" name="Go to service" sourceRef="Participant_Owner" targetRef="Start_ServiceVisit"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Notification" name="Service reminder" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Participant_Owner"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceAttended" name="Service attended" sourceRef="Participant_Owner" targetRef="Catch_ServiceAttended"/>

  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_App" name="Car service reminders" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_App">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_AppSystem" name="Police app">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ServiceRecorded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ServiceNecessary</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRegistration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Registered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyOwner</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ServiceAttended</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ThirtyDays</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IssueFine</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotRegistered</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ServiceAttended</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Fined</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ServiceRecorded" name="Successful service recorded">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ServiceRecorded" messageRef="Message_ServiceRecorded"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ServiceNecessary" name="Service necessary">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_ServiceNecessary">
        <bpmn:condition>${serviceNecessary}</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check car registration"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car registered?" default="Flow_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify car owner"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout" name="Wait for service or 30 days"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ServiceAttended" name="Service attended">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ServiceAttended" messageRef="Message_ServiceAttended"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ThirtyDays" name="30 days elapsed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_ThirtyDays">
        <bpmn:timeDuration>P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueFine" name="Fine car owner"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="Car not registered"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceAttended" name="Service attended"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Fine issued"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_1" sourceRef="Start_ServiceRecorded" targetRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_2" sourceRef="Catch_ServiceNecessary" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_3" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered" name="Registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${carRegistered}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="Not registered" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_4" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_5" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout" targetRef="Catch_ServiceAttended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_6" sourceRef="Gateway_AttendanceOrTimeout" targetRef="Catch_ThirtyDays"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_7" sourceRef="Catch_ServiceAttended" targetRef="End_ServiceAttended"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_8" sourceRef="Catch_ThirtyDays" targetRef="Task_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_App_9" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Car service facility work" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Facility">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Mechanic" name="Mechanic">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_ServiceVisit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterProblems</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendStatus</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RepairCar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterRepairSuccess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NextService</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Facility</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ServiceVisit" name="Car brought for service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ServiceVisit" messageRef="Message_ServiceVisit"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Enter car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatus" name="Send status updates by email"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RepairCar" name="Repair car"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterRepairSuccess" name="Enter successful repair and Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NextService" name="Enter time for next service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Facility" name="Service information recorded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_1" sourceRef="Start_ServiceVisit" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_2" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Task_SendStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_3" sourceRef="Task_SendStatus" targetRef="Task_RepairCar"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_4" sourceRef="Task_RepairCar" targetRef="Task_EnterRepairSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_5" sourceRef="Task_EnterRepairSuccess" targetRef="Task_NextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_6" sourceRef="Task_NextService" targetRef="End_Facility"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Owner" name="Car owner payment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Owner">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CarOwner" name="Car owner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_RepairCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PayThroughApp</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_OwnerPayment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RepairCompleted" name="Repair completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RepairCompleted" messageRef="Message_RepairCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PayThroughApp" name="Pay through the app"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OwnerPayment" name="Payment completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_1" sourceRef="Start_RepairCompleted" targetRef="Task_PayThroughApp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owner_2" sourceRef="Task_PayThroughApp" targetRef="End_OwnerPayment"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
